title: Which way?
goals: Reach the far end of the aisles.
The program asks the door whether it is locked.
starting_code:
# Ask the door with print if it is locked.
# Then take the way that is open.
hints: The door knows if it is locked. Ask for its attribute.
Use `print` to show the answer to your question.
The door is locked. You must take the long way round.
intro: The aisles form a loop. There is a short way up through a door. You should check if it is open first.
outro: You checked the door and found it locked. You took the only way.
learned: Now you know how to ask what a thing knows, which programmers call an attribute.
